ayahs.en: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
ayahs.e2: When the earth is shaken ˹in˺ its ultimate quaking
ayahs.tr: Izaa zul zilatil ardu zil zaalaha

ayahs.en: And the earth discharges its burdens
ayahs.e2: and when the earth throws out ˹all˺ its contents

ayahs.en: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it
ayahs.e2: and humanity cries, “What is wrong with it?”—

ayahs.en: That Day, it will report its news
ayahs.e2: on that Day the earth will recount everything

ayahs.en: Because your Lord has commanded it
ayahs.e2: having been inspired by your Lord ˹to do so˺

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَئِذࣲ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتࣰ ا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
ayahs.en: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds
ayahs.e2: On that Day people will proceed in separate groups to be shown ˹the consequences of˺ their deeds
ayahs.tr: Yawma iziy yas durun naasu ash tatal liyuraw a'maalahum

ayahs.ar: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرࣰ ا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.en: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it
ayahs.e2: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it
ayahs.tr: Famaiy ya'mal mithqala zarratin khai raiy-yarah

ayahs.ar: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةࣲ شَرࣰّ ا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.en: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it
ayahs.e2: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it
